$comment: Layer 05/06 delta L0506-D002 (TOOL-041): the prepared runtime JavaScript STRING domain (a string is a sequence of UTF-16 code units, including unpaired surrogates). Scenarios live in conformance/agent/prepared-runtime-string/, discriminated by a top-level `prepared_string` key. For each case a runner makes ONE tool call through the REAL Layer 06 pipeline (resolve, prepare_arguments, validation, the tools/pre-execute hook, execute) with a pre-execute listener that records the prepared value at each `observe` JSON pointer (and the keys of the object at each `observe_keys` pointer), and (custom tools) an execute that records the same. It performs no preparation, validation or string conversion itself. STRINGS are written as `units`: arrays of UTF-16 code units (integers 0..65535), so unpaired surrogates survive the scenario file; an observation renders the observed binding string back to its UTF-16 code units. A `prepare_set` VALUE is {"utf16": units} (a string), {"$key": units, "value": V} (an object with exactly that one key), an array or object of values, or a plain JSON scalar. HOOK REPLACEMENT (`hook_replace_set`, Minion's own Proceed(arguments=...) extension -- not a Pi behavior): the listener records its observations, then proceeds with the prepared arguments merged with these top-level values; execute's observations use `execute_observe`/`execute_observe_keys`. PREFLIGHT (language-neutral, before running a case; a violation fails the document, it is never defaulted): for outcome `prepared`, the keys of `observed` are exactly `observe`, the keys of `observed_keys` are exactly `observe_keys` (both absent or both present), `execute_observed` is present exactly when `hook_replace_set` is, with keys exactly `execute_observe`, and `execute_observed_keys` exactly when `execute_observe_keys` is, with keys exactly those pointers.

gate.$comment: Evidence staging, as L0506-D001-R003. `L0506-D002`: the delta's certification gate -- custom cases only, runnable from the accepted Layer 05/06 baseline in every binding. `WP-13.2`: an integration witness through the real built-in edit tool (TOOL-030), run by WP-13.2's Rust implementation review once the delta is certified; NOT part of the delta's certification. A runner never skips, aliases or simulates a document of the other gate; it filters by `gate` explicitly.

customCase.$comment: a tool whose own prepare_arguments returns the raw arguments merged with `prepare_set` (top-level keys), against the named schema kind: open = {type: object, properties: {}}; string = {text: {type: string}} required; min-length-2 / max-length-1 = {text: {type: string, minLength: 2 | maxLength: 1}}; pattern-one-char / pattern-two-chars = {text: {type: string, pattern: "^.$" | "^..$"}}; const-pair = {text: {const: U+1F600 (units [55357, 56832])}}; enum-lone = {text: {enum: [units [55296]]}}

editCase.$comment: the REAL built-in edit tool over a fresh root holding f.txt = "a\n" (its own prepare_arguments, prepareEditArguments); `file_utf8_hex` is the final f.txt bytes
